github_commands:
# Create Sprint 1 milestone
gh api repos/medancode420/PetPlantr/milestones \
  -f title="Sprint 1: Universal Breed Coverage" \
  -f description="Epic E-1: Complete breed dataset collection and validation" \
  -f due_on="2025-07-22T23:59:59Z"

# Get milestone number (run this after creating milestone)
MILESTONE_NUMBER=$(gh api repos/medancode420/PetPlantr/milestones | jq '.[] | select(.title=="Sprint 1: Universal Breed Coverage") | .number')

# Assign Sprint 1 stories to milestone
gh api repos/medancode420/PetPlantr/issues/$(gh issue list --search "in:title 1.1" --json number --jq ".[0].number") \
  -f milestone=$MILESTONE_NUMBER
gh api repos/medancode420/PetPlantr/issues/$(gh issue list --search "in:title 2.1" --json number --jq ".[0].number") \
  -f milestone=$MILESTONE_NUMBER
gh api repos/medancode420/PetPlantr/issues/$(gh issue list --search "in:title 3.1" --json number --jq ".[0].number") \
  -f milestone=$MILESTONE_NUMBER
gh api repos/medancode420/PetPlantr/issues/$(gh issue list --search "in:title 1.2" --json number --jq ".[0].number") \
  -f milestone=$MILESTONE_NUMBER
gh api repos/medancode420/PetPlantr/issues/$(gh issue list --search "in:title 1.3" --json number --jq ".[0].number") \
  -f milestone=$MILESTONE_NUMBER
